Participation in this experience should occur in at least one area of the expressive arts. According to the context this will be either a performance or a presentation.
All aspects of learning in expressive arts include opportunities to present and perform, for example through preparation of artwork for display, presentation of
a short improvised drama to members of the class or performance of dance or music to parents or in the community. At third level, as a culmination of
learning within their broad general education each young person should have the opportunity to contribute to a significant presentation (such as an exhibition)
or performance in at least one area of the expressive arts.
